17c73475e41269b53ea60d454a4a676b5cf15064.summary: BlueHat v17 conference slide deck by Billy Leonard of the Threat Analysis Group (November 2017) on ten years of targeted credential phishing. It traces how attackers changed delivery, persistence and exfiltration, and how defenses evolved. Techniques named include two-factor bypass, SMS interception and OAuth abuse. Defenses named include Password Alert, security keys and the Advanced Protection Program. Much of the deck is slide titles and source lists, and some site boilerplate is not recorded.

17d3d0b4c787d59bcdc0a051c4f0fbe2e3d248e0.summary: Symantec's Threat Hunter Team reports on Noberus ransomware (aka BlackCat, ALPHV). It describes Noberus as a successor to Darkside and BlackMatter, run by the group Symantec tracks as Coreid under a ransomware-as-a-service model. The report covers a new version of the Exmatter exfiltration tool, Eamfo credential theft from Veeam backups, and Noberus feature and affiliate-program changes from late 2021 through 2022.
